coverage_note: 协议固定 6 anchor；本轮因计入失败的首跑（32 HVP）与 smoke (16 HVP) 后全量 6 anchor 需 432>416 HVP，超出 round cap。对称减覆盖：每 cell 测 A/t0 + Bp/t16（t∈{0,16}），A/t48 两 anchor 本轮不测；round HVP 预算 304/416。

budget.accounting: round-total; failures/rechecks/salvage count; effective-batch evals and micro-forward calls kept as two simultaneous sets; old 18,000 ledger untouched, C1 billed separately; never divide C1 totals by 18000

stop_v: P frozen from the AUDIT bank's mean clipped g0 (C0 pair-baseline convention, a2v/b2v at t_after); applied to both banks for within-anchor comparability; ablation only, not an optimizer.
d_c_to_u: local c->U derivative, dev bank, post-update shadow state; clip-Jacobian factor not included; diagnostic only
memory: per-probe vectors freed after accumulation; only fp64 group sums and scalar projection lists persist within an anchor
